answer_1.quote: In this work we study methods for long-term open-domain conversation... We show that both techniques outperform conventional encoder-decoder Transformers, and that training models on our new task give long-term conversational abilities... The paper focuses on dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: We report more automatic metrics (F1 and BLEU) in Appendix A... We show validation perplexity... Table 4... Table 6... Table 15... These methods are compared using perplexity, BLEU, and F1.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation using crowdworkers... On each turn of the conversation the crowdworker is asked to check all attribute boxes that apply... At the end of the conversation, an additional question collects an overall engagingness score (out of 5) for their speaking partner.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers rate each bot response for attributes such as referencing partner's prior topics, referencing own topics, and overall engagingness; they also give an overall engagingness rating at the end of the conversation.
